turns.question: How did Nebius do in the second quarter of 2026?
turns.memo: Nebius grew revenue sharply while staying unprofitable on a GAAP basis. Revenues were $582.3m for the three months ended June 30, 2026. Loss from operations was $175.9m for the three months ended June 30, 2026. Net loss from continuing operations was $190.4m for the three months ended June 30, 2026. Adjusted EBITDA was $236.2m for the three months ended June 30, 2026. Adjusted net loss was $33.2m for the three months ended June 30, 2026.

turns.question: What drove operating cost growth?
turns.memo: Operating cost growth in the quarter reflected increases across all lines. Total operating costs and expenses were $758.2m for the three months ended June 30, 2026. Depreciation and amortization was $259.7m for the three months ended June 30, 2026. Product development was $191.0m for the three months ended June 30, 2026. Sales, general and administrative was $173.9m for the three months ended June 30, 2026. Cost of revenues was $133.6m for the three months ended June 30, 2026. Total share-based compensation expense included in those costs was $102.5m for the three months ended June 30, 2026.
